headline: License transfer for Veterans of Foreign War post at 14 Webster Court and manager change for Malden Fine Wines at 220 Pleasant St.
summary: The board will consider transferring a license from East Side Athletic Association Inc. to The Joseph Leon Mottolo, Post # 5424, Veterans of Foreign War at 14 Webster Court. It will also review a change in Officer/Director and manager application for VHN Corporation d.b.a Malden Fine Wines at 220 Pleasant St.
items: Transfer of license from East Side Athletic Association Inc. of Malden to The Joseph Leon Mottolo, Post # 5424, Veterans of Foreign War located at 14 Webster Court
Change in Officer/Director and change of manager application for VHN Corporation d.b.a Malden Fine Wines located at 220 Pleasant St
location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St Rm 108
plain_text:
CITY OF MALDEN
MASSACHUSETTS
Malden Licensing Board
Public Notice of Meeting & Agenda
Date of Meeting: Tuesday October 20, 2026, at 6 PM
Location: Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant St Rm 108
Meeting Agenda
1. Roll Call
2. Approval of Minutes from: September 15, 2026
3.  Business to be Considered:
A. A transfer of license of license from East Side Athletic Association Inc. of Malden 
to The Joseph Leon Mottolo, Post # 5424, Veterans of Foreign War located at 14
Webster Court. 
B. A change in Officer/Director and change of manager application for VHN 
Corporation d.b.a Malden Fine Wines located at 220 Pleasant St.
4. Adjournment
Kevin Molis, Chairman
Andrew Zeiberg, Member
Denise Balboni-Cowie, Member
